faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Rourkela Botany Expert recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Botany Expert post is 04 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Botany Expert position?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MSc in Botany from a recognized Indian university, followed by a postgraduate degree or diploma in Environmental Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Botany Expert post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Botany Expert position is 50 years, with relaxations available for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Botany Expert role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Botany Expert position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Botany Expert post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Botany Expert position at NIT Rourkela.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply by sending their complete application via email.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Rourkela located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Rourkela is located in Rourkela, Odisha, with the pincode 769008.

faq.question: Q10. Does the recruitment mention any required experience?
faq.answer: Yes, experience in physical, chemical, mechanical, and mineralogical analysis of soil is required for the Botany Expert position.
